name: NeuroChem
description: Interactive anatomical human brain pharmacology and pharmacokinetics explorer in Three.js with 10 compounds, 8 segmented brain structures, 5-stage timelines, multi-compound stacking, synergy/caution detection, and Web Audio sonification.

tools.name: select_compounds
tools.description: Select or combine up to 4 neuroactive compounds in NeuroChem, animate them in 3D, and return pharmacokinetics, active brain structures, and interactions.

tools.name: set_timeline_phase
tools.description: Set the pharmacokinetic timeline phase (0=0h Ingestion, 1=1h Early, 2=Peak Tmax, 3=t1/2 Clearance, 4=Years Chronic).

tools.name: focus_brain_region
tools.description: Rotate the 3D human brain camera smoothly to face a specific anatomical structure.

tools.name: check_stack_interaction
tools.description: Evaluate pharmacological synergy or clinical safety caution for a combination of compounds.

tools.name: list_compounds
tools.description: List all 10 neuroactive compounds with half-life, Tmax, target structures, and molecular reaction equations.
